title: Triangle inequality for the uniform norm
statement: For a finite nonempty set $\Omega$, a real number $q\ge 1$, and functions $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$, the uniform $L^q$ quantity of $f+g$ is at most the sum of the uniform $L^q$ quantities of $f$ and $g$.
